description: Independent historical XAUUSD reaction templates; no cross-report weights applied.

method.classification: Compare numeric Actual with numeric Forecast; above/below/inline.
method.baseline: Last completed M1 candle close at or before event timestamp.
method.horizons: Last completed M1 candle close at or before event timestamp + N minutes.
method.direction: up if midpoint change > 0; down if < 0; flat if == 0.
method.price_unit: USD per troy ounce, as represented by XAUUSD quotes.
